ANA Mileage Club miles

ANA Mileage Club miles book ANA and Star Alliance partner flights. On the AirMilesHK Marketplace, members list the ANA Mileage Club miles they have, and buyers make offers or request an award ticket. When a deal is agreed, AirMilesHK holds the payment until the seller delivers.

How it works

Trading ANA Mileage Club miles, safely

  1. Browse or listAnyone can browse ANA Mileage Club listings. Joining is free and needed to make an offer or list your own miles.
  2. Make an offerBid on part of a balance, the whole account where offered, or ask the seller to book an award ticket for you.
  3. Agree the termsThe seller accepts, counters or declines. Counter as often as you need.
  4. AirMilesHK in the middleThe buyer pays AirMilesHK, the seller delivers, and we release the payment once both sides confirm.
Most loyalty programmes, including ANA Mileage Club, do not allow selling or transferring miles or accounts. Please read the marketplace rules before you trade. Prefer a simple purchase? See AirMilesHK's own ANA Mileage Club page.
